Update researcher profile

Propose a correction to a published profile or add a missing internal or external researcher to the shared pool. Submitting does not publish a change. The current profile remains active until an administrator approves the request and the validated deployment succeeds.

What would you like to do?
Search the published directory by name or department. Results are ordered by last name. Selecting a person prefills the published profile. A stable registry ID, not the name, identifies the correction.
Optional: search ROR or enter the institution’s complete name. Only the institution search text goes to the same public ROR lookup used by Funded Awards. Affiliation remains subject to administrator review.

What will be sent

Only the fields in this form: the selected stable profile ID, name, research summary, expertise statements, ORCID, unit, optional institution name and selected ROR identity, relationship note, supporting links, optional contact email, and optional note. Browser-local teams, saved researchers, imported publication text, search history, uploaded files, and API keys are not sent.

Use only in Team Match

Stored only in this browser for Team Match. It is not submitted for administrator review or considered for the full catalog.

Request received

Status identifier:

View the non-sensitive submission status. Keep this link; contact information and proposed private notes are never shown there.

Rejected requests and private contact information are retained only for the bounded administrative period described by the submission service. Published researcher information remains auditable through repository history.

No API key is required. Funding Finder routes each feature through its tested hosted model.

Hosted AI sends only the bounded information needed for the feature to Funding Finder's protected Cloudflare service; provider keys are never sent to the browser. If you choose your own provider, a saved key stays in this browser's local storage until you remove it. Advanced users may instead select OpenAI or Anthropic and provide their own limited-use key after reviewing its spending controls: OpenAI key and project limits or Anthropic key safety and limits.

After opening a cited official notice from a result, use the source-check controls that appear on that result card. This checklist records whether the testing workflow itself worked.

On compatible mobile devices, “Send feedback” opens the share sheet with a JSON file attached. On desktop, it downloads the file for you to send separately. The file excludes API keys, profile/CV text, search text, Funding Finder search URLs, and chat.

Machine-extracted facts always require notice verification.

    Add a missing researcher

    Request catalog review or create a browser-only profile for Team Match.

    Matching opportunities

    Team Match screens current parent opportunities and publication-eligible child topics using the same local fielded and optional hosted semantic search assets as Funding Finder. Every displayed opportunity must also pass the team-specific evidence check for every selected researcher. Archived calls are excluded. Browser-only researcher profiles are stored only on this device.

    Enhanced ordering may send a bounded aggregate of selected research keywords and theme labels. Researcher names and publication text are not sent. The hosted ranking can only reorder opportunities that already passed every-researcher local fit.
